OWD5 cloud only. Devices are created per: Solo cloud OWD5. I dispositivi vengono creati per GroupId. Il writeback utilizza Group/UpdateGroup. Energia utilizza EnergyUsage/GetEnergyUsage con ThermostatID (Thermostats[].Id).
localAllowCommandsHelp: If the thermostat is connected locally, apply commands are sent directly to it (WD5: schedule, manual, comfort, boost, eco, frost protection). On failure or if unsupported, the cloud is used.
localBetaWarning: BETA: Local control is experimental and has not been confirmed on WD5-series thermostats (OWD5/MWD5) yet. Use at your own risk and please report your observations.
localHint:
The adapter runs its own device gateway. A local DNS record must point the hostname of the vendor's device gateway to the ioBroker host, then the thermostat has to be power-cycled.
Relay: the connection is passed on to the vendor cloud (app keeps working) and everything is read locally. Local only: the thermostat is answered by ioBroker and never contacts the cloud (WG4: needs one successful relay session first).
localUpstreamHostHelp: The hostname the thermostat connects to (see the DNS log of your router / Pi-hole / AdGuard).
localUpstreamPinHelp: Empty = the first certificate seen is trusted and stored.
notifyHint: Attiva le notifiche e seleziona i provider desiderati. L'adattatore rileva automaticamente le istanze in esecuzione – nessun numero di istanza richiesto.
